main_body: wooden choir stall with an overhanging top canopy (rows 8-14), five vertical recessed-arch backrest panels (rows 15-35), and a horizontal bench seat with five red cushions above a base apron (rows 36-47)
top_band: medium brown canopy top surface at rows 8-12 with a light tan front-edge highlight at row 12 (plus a second horizontal seat surface with red cushions at rows 37-40)
evidence: Reading down a middle vertical column: rows 8-12 form a 5-row foreshortened canopy top band ending in a distinct 1-row light tan front-edge line at row 12, overhanging a 2-row dark eave shadow at rows 13-14. Below that, rows 15-35 show the vertical backrest with inset arched panels (dark inner edges on top and sides). Rows 37-40 show a 4-row horizontal bench seat surface with red cushions and a light brown front edge at row 40, above a shadowed front apron at rows 41-46.

style.evidence: While the wood palette has 5 brown steps and uses dark brown outlines, the surface execution relies on mechanical horizontal stripes (unbroken single-colour rows across 46px at rows 10-12, 15, 40-41, 44-46) and repetitive copy-pasted backrest panels. Each arched panel interior (rows 20-31) is a flat untextured block, the middle backrest tiles contain only 4 colours with no wood grain, and the red cushions are flat 2-row solid bars without pillow shading.
